commit_note: HEAD when this record was generated. The record script data/results/collection_writeback_stall_20261024/record.py is not part of this commit; it is committed together with this file. The analysed cycles come from campaign benign-v4-20261022, captured with the collector of commit cbea764. values.host_at_record_time is read live from the host.

values.note: Every delta cycle of 2 s or more is listed with the host monitor samples taken inside it (summary rate fields only from samples whose whole 1 s interval lies inside the cycle); the two samples whose interval straddles the cycle start or end are listed separately as boundary and end_boundary, with in_cycle_s the part of their interval inside the cycle. The snapshot data of a full snapshot stays dirty in the page cache and is written back in bursts; during such a burst the DRAM-less SATA SSD runs at 100 % utilisation with the write rate falling to a few MB/s, and the collector uses no CPU for seconds. Within the measured cycle (total_ms) the collector of commit cbea764 creates, writes and renames snapshot files and hashes delta files on the sampling thread, so these waits extend the cycle; the SHA-256 of a full snapshot is computed by a separate thread after the cycle (output.hash_async), and the delta sidecar and the log line follow total_ms on the sampling thread and count only toward the scheduler slot. Which call waited is not recorded.
